Zeroes 0x24c-byte slots starting at DAT_ram_020d334c until the byte offset reaches 0x930, then returns zero. This clears four slots, not the three claimed by the first pass; no slot ownership/module evidence is supplied.

Calls __udivsi3 and returns extraout_r7 instead of a visible normal return value. Without the callee's register contract, r7 cannot safely be identified as a remainder, and the body does not expose both divmod results.
